advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the intended behavior for an offset-blind server returning keyless full pages (the offset-stall guard is skipped when page[0] has no `key`), and consider detecting stall by page identity/offset non-advance rather than first-key alone.
evidence: 331: first_key = page[0].get("key") if isinstance(page[0], dict) else None
332: if first_key is not None and first_key == prev_first_key:
Backstop at line 345: `if accumulated + len(page) >= _ACLI_CEILING:` raises reason='ceiling'.
ABSENCE: no test covers an offset-blind client whose issues lack a `key`; test doubles all set `"key"` (e.g. line 95 `{"key": f"DC-{i}", ...}`).
advisory.finding: The offset-stall guard is silently bypassed when the first issue of a page has no `"key"` (or is not a dict): `first_key` becomes `None` and the `if first_key is not None ...` condition short-circuits, so an offset-blind server serving full pages of keyless issues is not detected as a stall. It is still bounded by the `_ACLI_CEILING` backstop (accumulated grows by `len(page)` each iteration until it raises `reason='ceiling'`), so it will not loop forever, but it is misclassified as a ceiling truncation rather than the true offset-stall, and if a small `cap` is set it would instead return a wrong clipped set cleanly.
